force.title: The Health Reckoning
force.signature: GLP-1 drugs, the sober-curious wave, and the retreat from sugar are rewriting what people eat and drink — volume shrinks, and only the health-aligned or premium survive.

A \u00b7 The drug that changed appetite: Weight-loss drugs cut appetite and are already reshaping food, drink, and weight-loss demand.
Indulgent, calorie-dense categories face structural demand pressure as appetites shrink and scrutiny rises.
B \u00b7 The retreat from alcohol: Younger drinkers drink less; alcohol venues and makers face a structural, not cyclical, decline.
A boom-to-bust hangover: gluts, tariffs, and moderation hit premium spirits hard.
C \u00b7 The health-aligned winners: Sugar-free, functional, and 'better-for-you' positioning is the only growth lane left in beverages.
Health-conscious, convenient eating reshuffles who wins in packaged and prepared food.
Coffee, milk alternatives, and snacks reposition around health and premium to hold volume.
D \u00b7 The tensions: Value and indulgence collide with health scrutiny and GLP-1; chains reformulate or lose share.
Health warnings, sugar rules, and scrutiny become a cost and a repositioning trigger.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: wellness and weight-loss drugs shrink volume across food and drink; health-aligned and premium win, vice loses.
